execution_order.text: Governor Abdelahi Suley reaffirms his administration's commitment to boosting the agricultural sector.
Tractors and farm inputs are launched as part of the Nassarawa Accresal Hybrid Implementation Support Mission.
Governor Suley orders the contract for constructing a new road in Benway state.
The new road will significantly reduce travel time and improve accessibility.
The road will connect Awee Luka government area to Guma, benefiting people from Tarawa.
Dr. Joy Agene from the World Bank highlights the strong sustainability model of Nassarawa's progress.
Accresal Initiative has three components: landscape restoration, community landscape restoration, and sustainability.
Nassarawa State is leading in sustainability efforts.
